title: Read a supplied word
prompt: The checker supplies text under the name `word`. Print the text it gives you, followed by `Checked` on a separate line. A name without quotes reads the supplied value. With `word` set to `Mail`, the first line is `Mail`.
hints: Identify which output line depends on the supplied text.
A quoted word prints itself. An unquoted supplied name reads its value.
Check the order of the two print calls using the Gate case.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Prints the name of the input.

feedback: Identify which output line depends on the supplied text.
